cohort: 43 women who underwent surgery for severe deep pelvic endometriosis and desired pregnancy after surgery
finding: In women who underwent surgery for deep pelvic endometriosis, a cesarean section was not always necessary, even in cases of vaginal or rectal resection.
mod_finding: Of the 25 full-term pregnancies, 14 women (56%) had a vaginal delivery without complications, and 11 (44%) underwent a cesarean section.
